contract.words: Collect $8,000 of settled cash within 40 days using no up-front capital.

terms.proofCondition: $8,000 of settled cash received within 40 days

strategy.title: Fulfil the three accepted marina shrink-wrap orders through Harbor Wrap
strategy.why: Three written acceptances at $3,200 each ($9,600) exceed the $8,000 target; Harbor Wrap fulfils at a quoted $1,400 a marina, paid after the marinas pay, so no capital is advanced; cash settles in 14 days, inside the 40-day window.

alternatives.title: Sell to more of the 48 licensed marinas
alternatives.why: Not needed: the three agreements already exceed the target; extra sales would add conversion risk without being required.

facts.value: 48 recreational marinas are licensed by the state waterways division; each winterises its moored fleet once a year, every autumn.
Sell Shrink-wrapping and venting of every boat wintering in the marina's wet slips to each buyer.
Harbor Wrap Marine Services (quoted $1,400 a marina) quoted to do the work.

reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is supported: every chain link of the single member is established on the card — three WRITTEN_ACCEPTANCE agreements at $3,200 each for this buyer and this deliverable (price is a real purchase price, not another buyer's figure; conversion is measured, no new deals needed), supplier Harbor Wrap is the card's recorded fulfillment owner with an evidenced $1,400/marina quote, exposure/peak funding evidenced at $0 (supplier paid after the marinas pay), 14 days to cash against a 40-day window. Recomputed: 3 x $3,200 = $9,600 collected by day 14 >= $8,000 target; spend 3 x $1,400 = $4,200 on day 15 after receipts; min cash $5,400 >= 0, so no owner capital at any point (exposure cap $0 respected); cost below price. Ledger matches the steps and Brain's trace (collected 960000, maxExposure 0, problems none). Brain's NEEDS_EVIDENCE/CANDIDATE_ONLY reflects its 90%-calibration bar and an implausible hypothetical reconstruction it did not adopt, not a broken link in this plan.
findings: Net retained after paying the supplier is $5,400, below $8,000; the plan meets the target only on the contract's 'settled cash received' (gross collected) reading — the owner should know net margin is $5,400.
The SEND_A_MESSAGE, READ_REPLIES and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE capabilities the confirm/collect steps rely on are NOT_CONNECTED; they must be connected (or done by hand) before day 1.

The plan assumes Harbor Wrap can wrap all three marinas by day 7 and accepts payment after the marinas pay; the card records the quote and $0 exposure but no written schedule — confirm both with Harbor Wrap at the confirm step.
